sharing culture.reason: Research on absence serves the public interest; sharing is the default when the conditions hold.

single source of truth.reason: Rawafid is the source of its own attendance records.

legitimate purpose.reason: The study is legitimate, but names, IDs, employer and health notes go beyond it; onward sharing would change the purpose.

authorised access.reason: No named researchers; 'research partners when needed' is open-ended.

transparency.reason: Classification, storage, protection and destruction must be stated; today storage is abroad and retention indefinite.

collective accountability.reason: No agreement yet; roles and responsibilities must be signed.

data security.reason: A password-protected spreadsheet by email and a workspace outside the Kingdom.

ethical data use.reason: Children's health notes have no place in a commute study.
